410 shading::TypedAttributeKey<float> deepIDAttrKey(mDeepIDAttrIdxs[0]);
411 if (isect.isProvided(deepIDAttrKey)) {
412 cryptomatteParams->mId = isect.getAttribute<float>(deepIDAttrKey);
413 } else {
414 cryptomatteParams->mId = 0.f;
415 }
416 }
417 }
418
419 PathVertex pv(prevPv);
420
421 //--------------------------------------------------------------------
422 // Volumes
423 hitVolume = false;
424
425 // computeRadianceVolume() increases the pv.volumeDepth. We want the presence
426 // continuation ray's volume depth to be unchanged, so we restore it.
427 // Not doing this can cause problems with presence objects inside volumes
428 // if the max volume depth is low (default = 1). They will appear to 'hold out'
429 // the volume behind them as the max volume depth is reached.
430 int currentVolumeDepth = pv.volumeDepth;
431 float volumeSurfaceT = scene_rdl2::math::sMaxValue;
432
433 if (!ignoreVolumes) {
434 hitVolume = computeRadianceVolume(pbrTls, ray, sp, cameraId, pv, lobeType,
435 radiance, sequenceID, vt, aovs, deepParams, nullptr, &volumeSurfaceT);
436 if (hitVolume) {
437 indirectRadianceType = IndirectRadianceType(indirectRadianceType | VOLUME);
438 }
439 pv.pathThroughput *= vt.transmittance();
440 }
441
442 if (!hitGeom && aovs) {
443 // accumuate background aovs
444 aovAccumBackgroundExtraAovs(pbrTls, fs, pv, cameraId, aovs);
445 }
446
447 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
448 // Code for rendering lights, only executed for primary rays since lights
449 // appear in deeper passes already.
450 if ((ray.getDepth() == 0)) {
451
452 LightIntersection hitLightIsect;
453 int numHits = 0;
454 const Light *hitLight;
455 SequenceIDIntegrator sid(0, sp.mPixel, sp.mSubpixelIndex,
456 SequenceType::IndexSelection, sequenceID);
457 IntegratorSample1D lightChoiceSamples(sid);
458 hitLight = scene->intersectVisibleLight(ray,
459 hitGeom ? ray.getEnd() : sInfiniteLightDistance,
460 lightChoiceSamples, hitLightIsect, numHits);
461
462 if (hitLight) {
463 // Evaluate the radiance on the selected light in camera.
464 // Note: we multiply the radiance contribution by the number of
465 // lights hit. This is because we want to compute the sum of all
466 // contributing lights, but we're stochastically sampling just one.
467 LightFilterRandomValues lightFilterR = {
468 scene_rdl2::math::Vec2f(0.f, 0.f),
469 scene_rdl2::math::Vec3f(0.f, 0.f, 0.f)}; // light filters don't apply to camera rays
470 scene_rdl2::math::Color lightContribution = pv.pathThroughput * numHits *
471 hitLight->eval(pbrTls->mTopLevelTls,
472 ray.getDirection(), ray.getOrigin(), lightFilterR,
473 ray.getTime(), hitLightIsect, true, nullptr, ray.getDirFootprint());
474 radiance += lightContribution;
475 // If we hit a light that's opaque, set the transparency to the
476 // minimum volume transmittance: if the volume is not a cutout,
477 // volumeTransmittanceM == 0 and it is fully opaque. If the volume is
478 // a cutout, volumeTransmittanceMin > 0 and we are not fully opaque.
479 // If we hit a light that's not opaque, then we just use the volume
480 // alpha transmittance.
481 transparency = (hitLight->getIsOpaqueInAlpha() ?
482 reduceTransparency(vt.mTransmittanceMin) :
483 reduceTransparency(vt.mTransmittanceAlpha));
484
485 checkForNan(radiance, "Camera visible lights", sp, pv, ray, isect);
486
487 // LPE
488 if (aovs) {
489 EXCL_ACCUMULATOR_PROFILE(pbrTls, EXCL_ACCUM_AOVS);
490 const LightAovs &lightAovs = *fs.mLightAovs;
491 // transition
492 int lpeStateId = pv.lpeStateId;
493 lpeStateId = lightAovs.lightEventTransition(pbrTls, lpeStateId, hitLight);
494 // accumulate matching aovs
495 aovAccumLightAovs(pbrTls, *fs.mAovSchema, cameraId, *fs.mLightAovs,
496 lightContribution, nullptr, AovSchema::sLpePrefixNone, lpeStateId, aovs);
497 }
498
499 return indirectRadianceType;
500 }
501 }
502
503 if (!hitGeom) {
504 transparency = reduceTransparency(vt.mTransmittanceAlpha);
505
506 // Did we hit a volume and do we have volume depth/position AOVs?
507 if (ray.getDepth() == 0 && hitVolume && volumeSurfaceT < scene_rdl2::math::sMaxValue) {
508 aovSetStateVarsVolumeOnly(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, volumeSurfaceT, ray,
509 *scene, pv.pathPixelWeight, aovs);
510 }
511
512 return indirectRadianceType;
513 }
514 indirectRadianceType = IndirectRadianceType(indirectRadianceType | SURFACE);
515
516 CHECK_CANCELLATION(pbrTls, return NONE);
517
518 // Early return with error color if isect doesn't provide all the
519 // required attributes shader request
520 if (!isect.hasAllRequiredAttributes()) {
521 radiance += pv.pathThroughput * fs.mFatalColor;
522 return indirectRadianceType;
523 }
524
525 // Finalize Intersection setup.
526 geom::initIntersectionPhase2(isect,
527 pbrTls->mTopLevelTls,
528 pv.mirrorDepth,
529 pv.glossyDepth,
530 pv.diffuseDepth,
531 isSubsurfaceAllowed(pv.subsurfaceDepth),
532 pv.minRoughness,
533 -ray.getDirection());
534
535 isect.setCameraId(cameraId);
536
537 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
538 // Run the material shader at the ray intersection point to get the Bsdf
539
540 // Transfer the ray to its intersection before we run shaders. This is
541 // needed for texture filtering based on ray differentials.
542 // Also scale the final differentials by a user factor. This is left until
543 // the very end and not baked into the ray differentials since the factor
544 // will typically be > 1, and would cause the ray differentials to be larger
545 // than necessary. The mip selector is computed in this call also.
546 isect.transferAndComputeDerivatives(pbrTls->mTopLevelTls, &ray,
547 sp.mTextureDiffScale);
548
549 float rayEpsilon = isect.getEpsilonHint();
550 if (rayEpsilon <= 0.0f) {
551 // Compute automatic ray-tracing bias
552 float pathDistance = pv.pathDistance + ray.getEnd();
553 rayEpsilon = sHitEpsilonStart * scene_rdl2::math::max(pathDistance, 1.0f);
554 }
555 float shadowRayEpsilon = isect.getShadowEpsilonHint();
556
557 // Must be called post-transfer.
558 RAYDB_EXTEND_RAY(pbrTls, ray, isect);
559 RAYDB_SET_TAGS(pbrTls, lobe ? lobe->getType() : TAG_PRIMARY);
560
561 const scene_rdl2::rdl2::Material* material = isect.getMaterial()->asA<scene_rdl2::rdl2::Material>();
562 MNRY_ASSERT(material != NULL);
563
564 // perform material substitution if needed
565 scene_rdl2::rdl2::RaySwitchContext switchCtx;
566 switchCtx.mRayType = lobeTypeToRayType(pv.lobeType);
567 material = material->raySwitch(switchCtx);
568
569 shading::TLState* shadingTls = pbrTls->mTopLevelTls->mShadingTls.get();
570
571 // Presence handling code for regular rays
572 // Need to continue the current ray through the partially present geometry.
573 float presence = shading::presence(material, shadingTls, shading::State(&isect));
574
575 // Some NPR materials that want to allow for completely arbitrary shading normals
576 // can request that the integrator does not perform any light culling based on the
577 // normal. In those cases, we also want to prevent our call to adaptNormal() in the
578 // Intersection when the material evaluates its normal map bindings.
579 if (shading::preventLightCulling(material, shading::State(&isect))) {
580 isect.setUseAdaptNormal(false);
581 }
582
583 // Nested dielectric handling. Uses presence code for skipping false intersections.
584 // See http://graphics.idav.ucdavis.edu/~bcbudge/deep/research/nested_dielectrics.pdf
585 // This also enables automatic removal of self-overlapping geometry that's assigned to the
586 // same material.
587 int materialPriority = material->priority();
588
589 float mediumIor = 1.f;
590
591 // The material priority list can contain up to four materials that the
592 // path is currently inside and each material has a counter. This counter is
593 // incremented each time the path enters the material and is decremented each time
594 // the path exits. This count lets us ignore self-overlapping geometry that's assigned
595 // to the same material.
596 const scene_rdl2::rdl2::Material* newPriorityList[4];
597 int newPriorityListCount[4];
598 getPriorityList(ray, newPriorityList, newPriorityListCount);
599
600 int highestPriority;
601 const scene_rdl2::rdl2::Material* highestPriorityMaterial = getHighestPriorityMaterial(ray, highestPriority);
602 // The medium IOR is the material the intersection ray is currently in, i.e. the current
603 // highest priority material (or air if empty list.)
604 // See Ior.h::ShaderIor()... the meaning of mediumIor is reversed
605 // depending on whether we are entering or leaving the surface.
606 if (highestPriorityMaterial) {
607 mediumIor = shading::ior(highestPriorityMaterial, shadingTls, shading::State(&isect));
608 }
609
610 if (materialPriority > 0) {
611 int materialCount = 0;
612
613 if (isect.isEntering()) {
614 // have we already entered this material?
615 materialCount = getPriorityMaterialCount(material, newPriorityList, newPriorityListCount);
616
617 // add material to new priority list
618 addPriorityMaterial(material, newPriorityList, newPriorityListCount);
619 } else {
620 // remove material from new priority list
621 removePriorityMaterial(material, newPriorityList, newPriorityListCount);
622
623 // are we still inside this material?
624 materialCount = getPriorityMaterialCount(material, newPriorityList, newPriorityListCount);
625
626 // The medium IOR is the material we are going into, i.e. the new highest
627 // priority material (or air if empty list.)
628 int newHighestPriority;
629 const scene_rdl2::rdl2::Material* newHighestPriorityMaterial = getHighestPriorityMaterial(newPriorityList,
630 newHighestPriority);
631 if (newHighestPriorityMaterial) {
632 mediumIor = shading::ior(newHighestPriorityMaterial, shadingTls, shading::State(&isect));
633 } else {
634 //priority list is empty, reset back to 1.0
635 mediumIor = 1.f;
636 }
637 }
638
639 if (highestPriorityMaterial) {
640 if (materialPriority > highestPriority) {
641 // false intersection, continue the ray without shading and the
642 // medium ior isn't used
643 presence = 0.f;
644 }
645 if (materialCount > 0) {
646 // For this to be a valid non-self-overlapping intersection,
647 // the count must be zero. I.e. we are entering for the first time
648 // or exiting for the last time.
649 presence = 0.f;
650 }
651 }
652 }
653
654 isect.setMediumIor(mediumIor);
655
656 // If we terminate early, we do not want the contribution of the presence
657 // value in the pathThroughput or the pathPixelWeight.
658 scene_rdl2::math::Color earlyTerminatorPathThroughput = pv.pathThroughput;
659 float earlyTerminatorPathPixelWeight = pv.pathPixelWeight;
660
661 if (presence < 1.f - scene_rdl2::math::sEpsilon) {
662
663 // We will record cryptomatte information in this if block if necessary already.
664 // Don't double count by stating that the hit was false:
665 if (cryptomatteParams) {
666 cryptomatteParams->mHit = false;
667 }
668
669 float totalPresence = (1.0f - prevPv.totalPresence) * presence;
670
671 float rayNear = rayEpsilon;
672 float rayFar = ray.getOrigTfar() - ray.tfar;
673 if (totalPresence >= mPresenceThreshold || prevPv.presenceDepth >= mMaxPresenceDepth) {
674 // The cleanest way to terminate presence traversal is to make it impossible for the
675 // presence continuation ray to hit any more geometry. This means we assume empty space
676 // past the last presence intersection, which will set the pixel's alpha to the
677 // total accumulated presence so far. This is done by setting the ray's near and far
678 // distances to a large value.
679 // The other option is to assume a solid material past the last presence intersection.
680 // We don't want this because that would set the pixel alpha to 1 when we really want
681 // the alpha to be the total accumulated presence.
682 // Intuitively, you would just return here but that fails to set the path throughput
683 // and alpha correctly. There is not a clean way to explicitly set the pixel alpha,
684 // especially in vector mode where it is not accessible at all from the presence code.
685 rayNear = scene_rdl2::math::sMaxValue * 0.5f;
686 rayFar = scene_rdl2::math::sMaxValue;
687 }
688
689 // The origin and tfar has been moved to the geometry intersection
690 // point so the new tnear is just rayEpsilon. We also need to shorten the tfar
691 // appropriately so we don't overshoot the original ray length.
692 mcrt_common::RayDifferential presenceRay(ray, rayNear, rayFar);
693 setPriorityList(presenceRay, newPriorityList, newPriorityListCount);
694
695 // The above constructor increments the ray depth. We want to keep the parent ray's
696 // depth as the presence ray is a continuation of the same parent ray. Also, if the
697 // ray depth is incremented, lights are not visible through presence as the depth for
698 // continued camera rays is no longer 0.
699 presenceRay.setDepth(presenceRay.getDepth() - 1);
700
701 PathVertex newPv = pv; // new path vertex for continued ray
702 newPv.pathDistance += ray.getEnd();
703 newPv.pathPixelWeight *= (1-presence); // weight of continued ray
704 newPv.aovPathPixelWeight *= (1-presence); // weight of continued ray for aov use
705 newPv.pathThroughput *= (1-presence);
706 newPv.presenceDepth++;
707 newPv.totalPresence = totalPresence;
708 newPv.volumeDepth = currentVolumeDepth;
709
710 // LPE
711 // presence is a straight event
712 if (aovs) {
713 EXCL_ACCUMULATOR_PROFILE(pbrTls, EXCL_ACCUM_AOVS);
714 const FrameState &fs = *pbrTls->mFs;
715 const LightAovs &lightAovs = *fs.mLightAovs;
716 // transition
717 newPv.lpeStateId = lightAovs.straightEventTransition(pbrTls, pv.lpeStateId);
718 }
719
720 // We need to weight the continued ray and the regular shading appropriately.
721 // Scaling the throughput and pixel weight for the path handles this properly.
722 // Note that we don't need to scale the bsdf lobes of the material if we do this.
723 pv.pathPixelWeight *= presence; // weight of regular shading
724 pv.aovPathPixelWeight *= presence; // weight of regular shading for aov use
725 pv.pathThroughput *= presence;
726
727 // Construct new cryptomatte parameters to handle stacked presence objects.
728 CryptomatteParams newCryptomatteParams;
729 if (cryptomatteParams) {
730 newCryptomatteParams.mHit = false;
731 newCryptomatteParams.mId = 0.f;
732 newCryptomatteParams.mCryptomatteBuffer = cryptomatteParams->mCryptomatteBuffer;
733 }
734 CryptomatteParams *pNewCryptomatteParams = cryptomatteParams ? &newCryptomatteParams : nullptr;
735
736 // Fire continued ray and add in its radiance
737 scene_rdl2::math::Color presenceRadiance = scene_rdl2::math::sBlack;
738 float presenceTransparency;
739 VolumeTransmittance vtPresence;
740 unsigned presenceSequenceID = sequenceID;
741 bool presenceHitVolume;
742 computeRadianceRecurse(pbrTls, presenceRay, sp, cameraId, newPv, lobe,
743 presenceRadiance, presenceTransparency, vtPresence,
744 presenceSequenceID, aovs, nullptr, nullptr, pNewCryptomatteParams, false, presenceHitVolume);
745
746 radiance += presenceRadiance;
747 vt.mTransmittanceE *= vtPresence.mTransmittanceE;
748 transparency = (1 - presence) * presenceTransparency;
749
750 // We need to handle the case where we hit something with a presence of 1.0f (or without a presence)
751 // as we continue. To handle this case, we just check if the new cryptomatte params have the hit member set.
752 if (pNewCryptomatteParams && pNewCryptomatteParams->mHit) {
753 unsigned px, py;
754 uint32ToPixelLocation(sp.mPixel, &px, &py);
755 pNewCryptomatteParams->mCryptomatteBuffer->addSampleScalar(px, py, pNewCryptomatteParams->mId,
756 newPv.pathPixelWeight);
757 }
758
759 if (scene_rdl2::math::isEqual(presence, 0.f)) {
760 // Only the presence continuation ray contributes to the radiance so we can early out here.
761 return indirectRadianceType;
762 }
763
764 // Add the object with presence to the cryptomatte (at this point presence is gauranteed to be in (0, 1)).
765 if (cryptomatteParams) {
766 unsigned px, py;
767 uint32ToPixelLocation(sp.mPixel, &px, &py);
768 cryptomatteParams->mCryptomatteBuffer->addSampleScalar(px, py, cryptomatteParams->mId, pv.pathPixelWeight);
769 }
770 }
771
772 auto bsdf = arena->allocWithCtor<shading::Bsdf>();
773 shadeMaterial(pbrTls->mTopLevelTls, material, isect, bsdf);
774 stats.incCounter(STATS_SHADER_EVALS);
775
776 // Evaluate any extra aovs on this material
777 if (aovs) {
778 aovAccumExtraAovs(pbrTls, fs, pv, isect, material, cameraId, aovs);
779 }
780
781 CHECK_CANCELLATION(pbrTls, return NONE);
782
783 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
784 // Termination (did the shader request termination of tracing?)
785 if (bsdf->getEarlyTermination()) {
786 if (ray.getDepth() == 0) {
787 transparency = reduceTransparency(vt.mTransmittanceAlpha);
788 } else {
789 transparency = reduceTransparency(earlyTerminatorPathThroughput);
790 }
791
792 // if this is a primary ray, fill out the aovs
793 if (aovs) {
794 aovSetMaterialAovs(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, *fs.mLightAovs, *fs.mMaterialAovs,
795 isect, ray, *scene, *bsdf, ssAov,
796 nullptr, nullptr, earlyTerminatorPathPixelWeight, pv.lpeStateId, aovs);
797 }
798 if (aovs && ray.getDepth() == 0) {
799 aovSetStateVars(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, isect, volumeSurfaceT, ray, *scene, earlyTerminatorPathPixelWeight, aovs);
800 aovSetPrimAttrs(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, material->get<shading::Material>().getAovFlags(),
801 isect, earlyTerminatorPathPixelWeight, aovs);
802 }
803
804 if (depth && ray.getDepth() == 0) {
805 *depth = scene->getCamera(cameraId)->computeZDistance(isect.getP(), ray.getOrigin(), ray.getTime());
806 }
807
808 if (deepParams) {
809 // If we have terminated, don't output anything to the deep buffer
810 deepParams->mHitDeep = false;
811 }
812
813 if (cryptomatteParams) {
814 // If we have terminated, don't output anything to the cryptomatte buffer
815 cryptomatteParams->mHit = false;
816 }
817
818 return indirectRadianceType;
819 }
820
821 // if this is a primary ray, fill out the intersection and primitive attribute aovs
822 if (aovs && ray.getDepth() == 0) {
823 aovSetStateVars(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, isect, volumeSurfaceT, ray, *scene, pv.pathPixelWeight, aovs);
824 aovSetPrimAttrs(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, material->get<shading::Material>().getAovFlags(),
825 isect, pv.pathPixelWeight, aovs);
826 }
827
828 if (depth && ray.getDepth() == 0) {
829 *depth = scene->getCamera(cameraId)->computeZDistance(isect.getP(), ray.getOrigin(), ray.getTime());
830 }
831
832 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
833 // Self-emission
834 scene_rdl2::math::Color selfEmission = pv.pathThroughput * bsdf->getSelfEmission();
835 radiance += selfEmission;
836 // LPE
837 if (aovs) {
838 if (!isBlack(selfEmission)) {
839 EXCL_ACCUMULATOR_PROFILE(pbrTls, EXCL_ACCUM_AOVS);
840 const LightAovs &lightAovs = *fs.mLightAovs;
841
842 // transition
843 int lpeStateId = pv.lpeStateId;
844 lpeStateId = lightAovs.emissionEventTransition(pbrTls, lpeStateId, *bsdf);
845
846 // accumulate matching aovs
847 aovAccumLightAovs(pbrTls, *fs.mAovSchema, cameraId, *fs.mLightAovs, selfEmission,
848 nullptr, AovSchema::sLpePrefixNone, lpeStateId, aovs);
849 }
850 }
851
852 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
853 // Early out if we don't have any Bsdf lobes nor Bssrdf, VolumeSubsurface
854 if (bsdf->getLobeCount() == 0 && !bsdf->hasSubsurface()) {
855 RAYDB_SET_CONTRIBUTION(pbrTls, radiance / pv.pathThroughput);
856
857 if (aovs) {
858 aovSetMaterialAovs(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, *fs.mLightAovs, *fs.mMaterialAovs,
859 isect, ray, *scene, *bsdf, ssAov,
860 nullptr, nullptr, pv.aovPathPixelWeight, pv.lpeStateId, aovs);
861 }
862
863 return indirectRadianceType;
864 }
865
866 // Starting the integrator accumulator here is roughly equivalent of what
867 // the bundled code does.
868
869 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
870 // Have we reached the maximum number of bounces for each lobe types / overall
871 // Note: hair lobes are also glossy lobes. So the max depth for hair lobes
872 // would be max(mMaxGlossyDepth, mMaxHairDepth)
873 shading::BsdfLobe::Type indirectFlags = shading::BsdfLobe::NONE;
874 bool doIndirect = (mBsdfSamples > 0 && ray.getDepth() < mMaxDepth);
875 if (doIndirect) {
876 setFlag(indirectFlags, (pv.diffuseDepth < mMaxDiffuseDepth ?
877 shading::BsdfLobe::DIFFUSE : shading::BsdfLobe::NONE));
878 setFlag(indirectFlags, (pv.glossyDepth < mMaxGlossyDepth ?
879 shading::BsdfLobe::GLOSSY : shading::BsdfLobe::NONE));
880 setFlag(indirectFlags, (pv.mirrorDepth < mMaxMirrorDepth ?
881 shading::BsdfLobe::MIRROR : shading::BsdfLobe::NONE));
882 doIndirect = (indirectFlags != shading::BsdfLobe::NONE) ||
883 (pv.hairDepth < mMaxHairDepth);
884 // If doIndirect is true due to hairDepth only, then only side type bits
885 // are set in indirectFlags.
886 setFlag(indirectFlags, (doIndirect ?
887 shading::BsdfLobe::ALL_SURFACE_SIDES : shading::BsdfLobe::NONE));
888 }
889
890 CHECK_CANCELLATION(pbrTls, return NONE);
891
892 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
893 // For bssrdf/VolumeSubsurface or bsdfs which contain both
894 // reflection and transmission lobes or is spherical,
895 // a single normal can't be used for culling so skip normal culling.
896 scene_rdl2::math::Vec3f normal(scene_rdl2::math::zero);
897 scene_rdl2::math::Vec3f *normalPtr = nullptr;
898 if (!bsdf->hasSubsurface() && !bsdf->getIsSpherical() &&
899 ((bsdf->getType() & shading::BsdfLobe::ALL_SURFACE_SIDES) != shading::BsdfLobe::ALL_SURFACE_SIDES)) {
900 normal = (bsdf->getType() & shading::BsdfLobe::REFLECTION) ? isect.getNg() : -isect.getNg();
901 normalPtr = &normal;
902 }
903
904 // Gather up all lights which can affect the intersection point/normal.
905 LightSet activeLightSet;
906 bool hasRayTerminatorLights;
907 computeActiveLights(arena, scene, isect, normalPtr, *bsdf, ray.getTime(),
908 activeLightSet, hasRayTerminatorLights);
909
910 // Setup a slice, which handles selecting the lobe types and setup
911 // evaluations to include the cosine term.
912 // Note: Even though we may not be doing indirect for certain lobe types
913 // (according to indirectFlags), we still want to draw samples according
914 // to all lobes for direct lighting MIS.
915 shading::BsdfSlice slice(isect.getNg(), -ray.getDirection(), true,
916 isect.isEntering(), fs.mShadowTerminatorFix, shading::BsdfLobe::ALL);
917
918 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
919 // Estimate subsurface scattering
920 // Option 1: diffusion profile (bssrdf) approach
921 const shading::Bssrdf *bssrdf = bsdf->getBssrdf();
922 if (bssrdf != nullptr) {
923 // increment subsurface depth
924 pv.subsurfaceDepth += 1;
925 // Stop the accumulator here since the subsurface accumulator will be
926 // started up inside of computeRadianceSubsurface as needed.
927 radiance += computeRadianceDiffusionSubsurface(pbrTls, *bsdf, sp, cameraId, pv, ray,
928 isect, slice, *bssrdf, activeLightSet, doIndirect, rayEpsilon, shadowRayEpsilon,
929 sequenceID, ssAov, aovs);
930 }
931 // Option 2: path trace volumetric approach
932 const shading::VolumeSubsurface *volumeSubsurface = bsdf->getVolumeSubsurface();
933 if (volumeSubsurface != nullptr) {
934 // increment subsurface depth
935 pv.subsurfaceDepth += 1;
936 radiance += computeRadiancePathTraceSubsurface(pbrTls, *bsdf, sp, cameraId, pv, ray,
937 isect, *volumeSubsurface, activeLightSet, doIndirect, rayEpsilon, shadowRayEpsilon,
938 sequenceID, ssAov, aovs);
939 }
940
941 checkForNan(radiance, "Subsurface scattering", sp, pv, ray, isect);
942
943
944 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
945 // Early out if we don't have any Bsdf lobes
946 if (bsdf->getLobeCount() == 0) {
947 RAYDB_SET_CONTRIBUTION(pbrTls, radiance / pv.pathThroughput);
948
949 if (aovs) {
950 aovSetMaterialAovs(pbrTls, aovSchema, cameraId, *fs.mLightAovs, *fs.mMaterialAovs,
951 isect, ray, *scene, *bsdf, ssAov,
952 nullptr, nullptr, pv.aovPathPixelWeight, pv.lpeStateId, aovs);
953 }
954
955 return indirectRadianceType;
956 }
957
958 CHECK_CANCELLATION(pbrTls, return NONE );
959
960 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
961 // Estimate emissive volume region energy contribution
962 radiance += computeRadianceEmissiveRegionsScalar(pbrTls, sp, cameraId, pv, ray, isect,
963 *bsdf, slice, rayEpsilon, sequenceID, aovs);
964
965 //---------------------------------------------------------------------
966 // Setup bsdf and light samples
